_note: Friends' copies of Get Jacked. Passwords are stored only as SHA-256 of the lower-cased password. Run `npm run build:friends` after editing this file or the app; icons: python3 scripts/friend-icons.py <slug> (artwork in friends-src/<slug>-car.jpg). Optional "theme": a folder in themes/ (theme.json + CSS + assets) restyling only that friend's copy.
